title: Example issues
description: Bugs, features, and planned work for a fictional example application. Use this collection to track work, priorities, and outcomes. This is not the means project's backlog.

title.description: A short description of the work or problem.

type.description: Task for general work, bug for incorrect behavior, or feature for new functionality.

status.description: Todo before work starts, in_progress while working, done after acceptance criteria are met, or canceled when intentionally abandoned.

priority.description: Relative importance, ordered urgent, high, normal, then low.

tags.description: Optional labels for grouping related issues.
